text: EMIs are scheduled for the 5th of each month. The actual debit time depends on the customer's bank and active repayment mandate.
Customers can check their next EMI due date in the Nivara Finance customer portal. The loan account dashboard displays the upcoming instalment and outstanding balance.
Customers should maintain sufficient funds in their linked bank account before the EMI due date. A successful debit depends on the bank and the active repayment mandate.

If an EMI has not been debited by the end of its scheduled date, customers should check their bank statement and loan account status. They can contact customer support if the payment status remains unclear.
Nivara Finance supports repayment through an active bank auto-debit mandate. Customers should check that their linked bank account and mandate are active before the EMI date.
Customers can make eligible loan repayments through the payment option available in the Nivara Finance customer portal. Available methods and transaction instructions are displayed during payment.

Customers should retain the transaction reference for any online loan repayment. If the payment is debited but not reflected in the loan account, they should contact support with the transaction details.
Cash deposits at Nivara Finance branch counters are not supported for loan repayment. Customers should use an approved digital payment method or their active bank mandate.

A bounced EMI occurs when a scheduled repayment fails, for example because of insufficient funds or an inactive mandate. Customers should check their bank account and repayment status to identify the issue.
Nivara Finance charges a fictional payment-bounce fee of ₹500 for each failed scheduled EMI debit. This fee is separate from any applicable late-payment charge.

After a failed EMI debit, customers should resolve the underlying payment issue and follow the repayment instructions in their customer portal. A retry is not guaranteed, so customers should check the current loan account status.

Foreclosure means closing a loan before its scheduled end by paying the outstanding amount required for closure. Nivara Finance applies a fictional foreclosure charge of 3% of the outstanding principal.
Customers can request a foreclosure statement through the Nivara Finance customer portal. The statement provides the amount payable for closing the loan and its stated validity period.
A loan is not considered foreclosed merely because a customer requests closure. The required outstanding amount and applicable charges must be paid, and the account must be processed for closure.

Part-payment means paying an additional amount toward the loan principal without closing the entire loan. Nivara Finance applies a fictional part-payment charge of 2% of the additional principal paid.
Eligible customers can request a part-payment through the customer portal. The portal provides the applicable instructions and any eligibility conditions for the loan account.

A part-payment reduces the outstanding loan principal after it is processed. Its effect on the remaining EMI amount or loan tenure depends on the loan terms and the servicing option confirmed by Nivara Finance.
Customers can download their loan account statement from the Nivara Finance customer portal. The statement shows recorded repayments, charges, and other available account transactions.
An interest certificate summarises the interest recorded for a loan during the specified financial period. Customers can request the available certificate through the customer portal.

Customers can review their recorded EMI payment history in the loan account dashboard. If a transaction is missing or appears incorrect, they should contact support with the relevant payment reference.
Nivara Finance customer support operates Monday through Saturday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Indian Standard Time. The support desk is closed on Sundays.

Customers can contact Nivara Finance through the support option in the customer portal. They should provide their loan account reference and a clear description of the issue when submitting a request.
Customers can check the status of a previously submitted service request through the customer portal. If the status has not changed, they can follow up with the existing request reference.
Customers can view their registered contact details in the Nivara Finance customer portal. Requests to update those details must follow the verification process displayed in the portal.
Customers can find their loan account reference in the customer portal dashboard. They should use that reference when contacting Nivara Finance about repayments, statements, or servicing requests.
